name: workflowwright
description: WorkflowWright — assign each workflow step to the cheapest resource that can actually do it, then compile the decision into artifacts that cannot drift apart.

plugins.name: workflowwright
plugins.description: Design, critique, and scaffold agent workflows. Forces the code-vs-agent-vs-human assignment for every step, bounds every retry loop, and generates a runnable orchestrator whose failure paths are defined rather than discovered.
